report_identity.report_title: JH Educational Technology INC. 2025 Annual Report

business_overview.one_sentence: The Group principally provides higher and secondary education services in the PRC through PRC Operating Schools controlled under structured contracts.

segments.business_substance: Tuition, boarding and other education service fees

business_overview.revenue_model: Students generally pay tuition and boarding fees in advance before the academic year; revenue is recognised over the relevant program period.
business_notes: All revenue was generated in the PRC and 98% of long-term assets/capital expenditure were located/incurred in the PRC.
PRC Operating Schools contributed 99.6% of 2025 revenue, 109.6% of 2025 net profit and 98.6% of total assets as at 31 December 2025.

non_recurring_items.item: Loss on disposal of property, plant and equipment
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Mainly write-off of residual value of student dormitory decoration after renovations

non_recurring_items.item: Changes in fair value of investment properties
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Fair value loss included in other expenses
Government grants related to expenses and assets

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks and on hand
Non-pledged time deposits; original maturity split between less than three months, three months to one year, and more than one year

operating_assets.source: 2025 Annual Report consolidated statement of financial position, page 134

operating_assets.business_substance: Land use rights, school premises and leased office/property assets
Tuition and boarding fees receivable from students in financial difficulty

investment_assets.business_substance: Properties leased to tenants under operating leases
investment_assets.source: 2025 Annual Report consolidated statement of financial position and note 15, pages 134 and 186

other_assets.business_substance: Goodwill related to College of Economics and Business CGU
Includes prepayment for PPE, loans to third parties, interest receivables and operating deposits

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current and non-current bank loans; secured loans pledged by tuition fee rights

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Tuition and boarding fees received in advance and expected to be recognised within one year
Salaries, student advances, taxes, receipts on behalf of service providers, textbook payables and other operating payables

other_liabilities.business_substance: Government grants for construction and future costs or expenses

other_liabilities.source: 2025 Annual Report consolidated statement of financial position, page 134
